args.question: Why did the three earlier parties never come out of Manufactory Nine, and why can Ode Marran remember every turn of the loop when they cannot? Explain the mechanism. Cite the excerpts.

label: Ask the book
output:
The three earlier parties never left Manufactory Nine because they were caught in a time loop that lasts a little under an hour [2]. The mechanism of this loop is that whenever it ends and starts again, anyone inside who "can't feel it" forgets the entire turn and lives it fresh [2]. Consequently, these parties are not dead, but have spent nine years repeatedly walking into the facility, forgetting their progress every hour [2].

Odeline Marran is able to remember every turn of the loop because she is one of the few who can "hold the deep Facets back" [7]. While others are reset to the threshold and their memories are wiped when the hour turns, Ode has remained conscious of the repetitions, living the same hour for nine years [5, 6]. This has allowed her to observe the environment extensively, such as watching the shaft to the Keystone "fold and unfold a thousand times" to learn the exact timing of its movements [7].
